fix(bridge): size CAGRA itopk by the requested top-k

cuvsCagraSearchParams.itopk_size defaults to 64, so a query with limit k
above 64 was silently capped (the CPU fallback hid it on the baseline).
Raise it to topk before searching, so limit 70..200 returns k rows.

feat(vector): defer the VSAG CPU graph while cuVS CAGRA is active

When an index is created with lib=cuvs, inserts currently feed both the
cuVS GPU graph and the VSAG CPU graph. The CPU graph is ~93% of the build
time, so paying for it doubles the CAGRA build window.

This adds OB_CUVS_DEFER_VSAG=1 (default: off, baseline behaviour):
 - add_index only buffers rows (vector + vid) instead of inserting into
   VSAG; the GPU graph is built from the same buffer on first search;
 - a buffered row is deduplicated by vid (the delta index and the snapshot
   both call add_index for the same row);
 - ob_cuvs_materialize() replays the buffer into VSAG on demand when the
   GPU cannot answer a request, then stops deferring so later inserts keep
   both graphs consistent.

The dense entry keeps GPU first; the iterating entry materialises up front
because it serves candidates batch by batch and one-shot GPU top-k cannot.
Filtered-query semantics are unchanged with the flag off.
